title: mysql driver Buckety parameters
description: Schema for Buckety.spec.parameters when the resolved driver is mysql. All values are strings per the CRD contract. Omitted parameters are unmanaged: the server's character_set_server/collation_server defaults apply at creation and the driver never compares them afterwards. Both parameters are set at creation and immutable; the driver never alters an existing database's defaults (that would not convert its tables), so a database whose defaults differ - changed out of band, or adopted - surfaces ParameterDrift.

characterSet.description: Default character set of the database, e.g. utf8mb4. "utf8" is refused as ambiguous (utf8mb3 today, utf8mb4 in future server versions); name utf8mb4 or utf8mb3.

collation.description: Default collation of the database, e.g. utf8mb4_unicode_ci. Use the full name as information_schema.SCHEMATA reports it, or the value will read as drift.
